text:
Lina: quick design check — thinking through the playground streaming UX changes. moved token counter to a small top-right badge, and exploring a single control that toggles between Stop and Regenerate instead of two separate buttons. prompt library would live in a collapsible right rail. attaching mock: https://figma.redwood/playground-stream-v4
Ethan: badge looks cleaner but discoverability worries me. users might not notice tokens if it's subtle. maybe show full breakdown on hover and a persistent mini-summary for power users.
Riya: from runtime POV we need to emit partial token estimates during streaming. also important: aria-live for partial content so screen readers get updates. stopping needs to cancel the generator server-side and surface a clear message.
Noah: prefer a prominent single button in the message area. dropdowns are extra clicks. idea: same slot is a red "Stop" while streaming, then flips to blue "Regenerate" once stream ends. less visual clutter.
Lina: yeah that's the idea. while streaming: show "Stop generation" pill (aria-pressed false -> true?), when finished convert to "Re-run". keyboard shortcut suggestion: "Cmd+."
Ethan: agree on toggle. token counter — what about showing delta per message inline (tiny +12) and aggregate badge in header? small inline numbers help tune prompts.
Riya: we can calculate token delta on finalize; streaming estimates are noisy. sending per-token events increases bandwidth, so maybe estimate locally then replace with exact after completion.
Noah: accessibility nits: token badge color contrast needs to hit AA (4.5:1 for text). in dark mode some of the pinks dip below threshold.
Lina: noted — will update palette. also copy tweak: use explicit labels for assistive tech: "Stop generation" vs just "Stop". and add aria-live="polite" on the output container so it doesn't interrupt.
Ethan: mobile/responsive thoughts — right rail becomes bottom sheet; the token badge should float above content, not obstruct the composer. also gestures for quick regenerate? might be heavy.
Riya: prompt library storage: pinned prompts should be org-scoped, favorites per-user. api required: GET /prompt-library, POST /prompt-library/pin. I'll spec endpoints after design lock.
Noah: let's run a 5-person usability quick test on these flows (stop discoverability, token visibility, prompt insertion). I'll book tomorrow.
ConsoleBot: deploy-bot: mock images uploaded to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/playground-stream-v4.png
Riya: will add aria focus management and a focus trap when the rail opens. also will include keyboard focus styles for the token badge.
Lina: pushing updated figma with accessible color tokens and copy tweaks. change suggestions: "Stop" -> "Stop generation" (visible label), "Regenerate" -> "Re-run" for brevity.
Ethan: keyboard shortcuts proposal:
```
Stop: Esc
Run/Re-run: Cmd+Enter (Win: Ctrl+Enter)
Insert snippet: Alt+P
```
Noah: ok lock those but call out conflict with browser shortcuts for docs. I'll write the RFC for keyboard mappings.
Lina: thanks — I'll iterate the mock and post a short video of the interaction. :thumbsup:
Ethan: small follow-up: show a transient toast when regen fails with specific token cost info for the attempt.
Riya: noted, will include error states in PR (500 cancel, 429 throttled, streaming timeout).
Noah: great thread. Lina drop the updated figma link here when ready and I'll move to engineering grooming.
